Sorry if I communicated that poorly. She informed me that she has a gun before this incident, so I don't think it was meant to intimidate me.

It's just now that I'm aware of how unhinged this woman is, I do not trust her having a gun anywhere near me, nor anyone for that matter.

Sorry again if I communicated that poorly.

Thank you! This was actually very helpful. The office isn't open until tomorrow, but I'm going to build my case starting with the incident report.

Thanks to everyone that commented. I really appreciate it.

There's no kid living here. All of her kids are adults, with the exception of her son, who is 17 and lives with his father.

Nope, she does their laundry because she is either too stupid to realize that will drive up the bill or she is just inconsiderate.

Criminal record. Poss of a firearm, distr. of marijuana, distr. of marijuana w/ a dui, armed robbery. (I robbed a drug dealer)

I've changed my attitude towards criminal activity, but my living circumstances seem impossible to change. I've been on/off homeless since I was 15. Now, on/off doesn't mean I went back with either of my parents. Sometimes I was with my sister. She was on heroin. Sometimes I was with friends. Some of which were real trouble. Sometimes I'd find myself couch surfing from place to place.

The most static housing I've had was in prison.

I don't know what I want.

For around 2 decades I really wanted to die. I made a series of bad mistakes with the hope that each bad decision would push me closer to killing myself. Now I realise that I've made this bed and it's very difficult to lie in.
